# BrandBite (eatbrandbite.com)

> Live fast-food menu news, weekly rotating Specials On Now (Crumbl, PopUp Bagels, Insomnia Cookies, Salt & Straw, Jeni's), verified promo codes, packaged snack drops, community sightings, fully pseudonymized reader discussions, and original first-hand taste tests across 168 U.S. chains and snack brands. Zero calorie counting; zero fabricated reviews.
